findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_recipes, get_recipe, get_cook_steps, build_shopping_list, plan_meals, delete_recipe, get_my_recipe_feedback, get_my_stats, suggest_from_pantry, cook_profile · Private data: search_recipes, create_recipe, fork_recipe, update_recipe, get_my_recipe_feedback, rate_recipe, get_my_kitchen, cook_profile · Public sink: order_groceries, draft_recipe, create_recipe, generate_placeholder_cover, rate_recipe, pantry · Destructive: update_shopping_list, update_meal_plan, delete_recipe, pantry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_recipes, get_recipe, get_cook_steps, build_shopping_list, plan_meals, delete_recipe, get_my_recipe_feedback, get_my_stats, suggest_from_pantry, cook_profile · Private data: search_recipes, create_recipe, fork_recipe, update_recipe, get_my_recipe_feedback, rate_recipe, get_my_kitchen, cook_profile · Public sink: order_groceries, draft_recipe, create_recipe, generate_placeholder_cover, rate_recipe, pantry · Destructive: update_shopping_list, update_meal_plan, delete_recipe, pantry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
